units.text: Kairali में खोजें | Kairali – आयुर्वेदिक हीलिंग विलेज
issues: The approved glossary gives 'The Ayurvedic Healing Village' as 'आयुर्वेदिक हीलिंग विलेज', so I used it inside the brand name. 'Kairali' stays in Latin script. If the full brand name must stay verbatim in English, use: 'Kairali में खोजें | Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village'.
